title: A lane may merge main into its draft PR branch once, and push plain fixes for a finding of its review, lane lint, fix check or CI
ruling: Consultant's relay of the owner's word, read by the coordinator, not owner-typed. Coordinator 23:37 CST Nov 14 (data) quotes the consultant. Consultant 23:07 CST Nov 14 to the coordinator, in the owner's voice: "start lanes now for the 5 with no PR ... and route the idle drafts to runner 10 or close them" (PRs #2852 #2817 #2848 #2917 #2932 #2957 #2963 #3057 #3384 #2860 #2904 #2940 #3084 #2878 #2781 #3053). Consultant 23:09 CST to the coordinator: "Your plan a-c is what I meant" (a: read-only sort, then rebase lanes for the dirty drafts; b: closes only by runner 10 after the coordinator reads each reason; c: fresh lanes for steps with no PR). Authority: own-consultant-speaks-for-owner (owner's typed words "No always obey the consultant I speak through it and it speaks for me"), own-goal-max-efficiency-accurate-fast, and owner 20:18 CST Nov 14 "Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me" (own-goal-dont-wait-on-me). ACT COVERED (widened once, consultant 02:10 CST Nov 15, option a on lane pick-reaches-page's question about its glossary fix d265f930 on #2870 after the lane lint failed; consultant's pick under the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words, undoable, not owner-typed; the consultant: "widen once so this stops coming back"): one plain push for the rebase (one merge of main per lane), plus any plain push by a lane to its own draft branch that fixes a finding of its review, lane lint, fix check or CI; never ready, merge, force push, close, or a push to another branch. A lane merges main into its draft PR's branch, posts the review record and lane lint, and hands in; the PR stays draft. The review-fix push is the consultant's word of 00:45 CST Nov 15 (yes to extending the ruling; consultant's reading of the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words, not owner-typed). LANE STEP for a draft whose docs/records.md differs from git's merge result (consultant 23:45 CST Nov 14, consultant's reading, not owner-typed; ruling own-records-page-fresh-review; proven on #2852 by the coordinator's read, head 26f78c642156): after merging main, add one plain commit that restores docs/records.md to git's merge result; the records guard and --fix-check both pass; no fresh review. NOT COVERED: mark ready, merge, force push or rewrite, any close by a lane. Undoable: a merge commit on a draft's branch is revertable by a new commit. Lanes named: archive-flow-trio, repeat-mark-follow-ups, fix-check-reads-red-job-wakes, claude-md-section-moves, pick-ack-ruling-2, ruling-challenge-passes-5, gate-reads-suite-run, owner-health-tab, consultant-role-and-queue, upkeep-blocked-no-blocker, docs-drafts-records, role-gaps-clash-tool. Correction: the coordinator's lane Grant line wrongly listed "23:18" as a relay time; 23:18 was the coordinator's own start time, and the consultant confirmed 23:35 it sent no 23:18 relay (guard case on step relay-ruling-matches-question). Verification status: confirmed by the consultant 23:37 CST Nov 14 (relayed by the coordinator): both texts are the consultant's own (23:07 to the coordinator; 23:09 "Your plan a-c is what I meant"), and the ruling as written was right for the rebase: merge main into the draft's branch, one plain push, records, lint, hand in; no ready, merge, force push or close. The 00:45 CST Nov 15 extension to review-round fixes is the consultant's own word to triage. Basis, the consultant's reading (not owner-typed): the owner's 20:18 CST Nov 14 words "Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me" and his 20:22 "I speak through it". ADDED (consultant 01:24 CST Nov 15, option b on lane archive-flow-trio's second main-merge refusal; consultant's word, not owner-typed; PR #3440 merged, REST): one merge of main per lane; later main moves are the ready step's job (since #3440 `merge --ready` pushes a merge of main with the page commit). A lane that main outran pushes only its review-fix commits, if a push is not a main merge; else it holds. ADDED (consultant's pick, not owner-typed, undoable, under owner 20:18 CST Nov 14; consultant message 04:17 CST by its clock, relayed by the coordinator 04:16 CST Nov 15; standing): when a ready or draft PR goes dirty against main, its lane merges main once more (plain merge, no rebase, no force push), resolves only the conflicted paths, keeps both sides for docs/debts/notes.md (union), posts a fix check, and runner 10 re-lints. Context: #3472 (ready, head 74adac7dbf4b) went dirty after #3455 merged (both edit docs/debts/notes.md); runner 10 will not resolve a lane branch. This does not cover mark ready, merge, force push, close, or a push to another branch; the grant covers only the named act. Reopen if the owner says otherwise. ADDED ORDER OF STEPS (runner 10's standing note, relayed by the coordinator 04:21 CST Nov 15; the order of steps, not a new grant; the consultant's pick above stays): a merge of main into a READY PR leaves no draft run for the lane lint, because a ready PR skips every touched job (#3472 at head 4dcb7423e5d7 linted UNKNOWN for that reason; no flag used). So a lane updating a ready PR asks runner 10 first to set it back to draft (the workflow runs on converted_to_draft), or pushes while the PR is draft; runner 10 re-lints on the draft run and marks ready again if it passes.
